name: MedNLI
intro: MedNLI是一个面向临床领域的自然语言推理（NLI）数据集。该数据集由医生基于患者的真实病历进行标注，旨在推动模型在知识密集且数据有限的专业领域（如医疗）中的应用。研究者通过利用开放域数据的迁移学习和医学术语等领域知识，有效提升了模型的性能。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
task_type: 自然语言推理, 分类
intro_en: MedNLI is a clinical domain natural language inference (NLI) dataset. It is annotated by doctors based on real patient records, aiming to advance model applications in knowledge-intensive and data-scarce specialized fields like medicine. Researchers have effectively improved model performance by leveraging transfer learning from open-domain data and incorporating domain knowledge such as medical terminology.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart TD
    A[MIMIC-III v1.3 Database] --> B(临床病历)
    B --> C[规则程序分割病历章节]
    C --> D(病史部分)
    D --> E[Lingpipe句子分割器]
    E --> F(候选前提句池)
    F --> G{随机抽样}
    G -- 抽样前提句 --> H[临床医生标注]
    H --> I{生成假设句}
    I -- 肯定为真 --> J(蕴含)
    I -- 可能为真 --> K(中立)
    I -- 肯定为假 --> L(矛盾)
    H --> M[标注指南]
    M --> N{Quality Control}
    N -- 丢弃无效前提 --> O(有效前提)
    N -- 飞行研究与协议一致性计算 --> P(高一致性标注)
    P --> Q[数据集拆分]
    Q --> R(Training Set)
    Q --> S(开发集)
    Q --> T(Test Set)
    T --> U[Evaluation方法]
    U --> V[基于特征的系统]
    U --> W[神经网络模型]

flowchart LR
    A["Extract Past Medical History sections from patient records as source material"] --> B["Apply biomedical-trained sentence splitter to obtain candidate premise sentences"]
    B["Apply biomedical-trained sentence splitter to obtain candidate premise sentences"] --> C["Randomly sample subset of candidate premises for annotation"]
    C["Randomly sample subset of candidate premises for annotation"] --> D["Present sampled premises to clinician annotators without additional context"]
    D["Present sampled premises to clinician annotators without additional context"] --> E["Clinicians write hypothesis sentences for entailment, neutral, and contradiction categories"]
    E["Clinicians write hypothesis sentences for entailment, neutral, and contradiction categories"] --> F["Evaluate models using transfer learning from open-domain datasets like SNLI"]
    F["Evaluate models using transfer learning from open-domain datasets like SNLI"] --> G["Incorporate domain knowledge from medical terminologies and external lexical sources"]
